name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/site-styles
description: This site's application CSS: the stack declaration, then v4's five ITCSS tiers under the site layer, and the site's self-hosted fonts. A site plugin: a repo-only package, never published (private), loaded by package name like every other plugin of ours. See CONTEXT.md.
//devDependencies: Build-time only. Sass compiles the tiers and esbuild inlines the result into dist/index.js, which imports nothing at run time.

quartz.name: site-styles
quartz.//defaultOrder: Below every other plugin, so the stack declaration is the first named-layer statement after core's index.css (ADR-0003, site-plugin amendment).
